title: First Anglo-Mysore War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "First Anglo-Mysore War", at revision 1370618327, opens: "The First Anglo-Mysore War (1767–1769) was a conflict in India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company. The war was instigated in part by the machinations of Asaf Jah II, the Nizam of Hyderabad, who sought to divert the company's resources from attempts to gain control over the Northern Circars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q617070, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict in India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company.". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
